_about: 5-frame deterministic capture SHA-256 baseline. Pinned 2026-07-15. Any drift between a fresh capture run and these hashes indicates a non-determinism regression in port/rendering (time.time()-used-as-seed, unseeded random, etc). Regenerate via: python port/capture_after_seq.py && python -m pytest tests/test_sanity_deterministic_frames.py::test_sanity_across_deterministic_frames (the determinism test will tell you the new SHAs; if you accept them, overwrite this JSON with the printed ones and commit).

_meta.tolerance: exact byte equality (PNG encoding is deterministic for the same pixel buffer)
